name: PayPal Checkout
summary: A buyer-wallet and checkout product for PayPal, cards, Venmo, Pay Later, and eligible alternative methods.

pricing.headline: US PayPal Checkout is 3.49% + $0.49; standard card payments are listed separately.
pricing.assumptions: US PayPal Checkout transaction. US cross-border commercial transactions add 1.5%; currency conversion and dispute or chargeback fees vary by transaction and account status.

sellerCoverage: Business-account onboarding, receiving, withdrawal, features, and fee schedules are country-specific; a country-code list alone does not establish full merchant support.
buyerCoverage: PayPal reaches international buyers, subject to buyer country, funding source, and product availability.
products: Broad eligible goods and services subject to PayPal acceptable-use and seller-protection rules.

features.checkout: PayPal-branded checkout and Expanded Checkout options.
features.invoicing: PayPal Invoicing is available as a related business product.
features.paymentMethods: PayPal balance, cards, Venmo in the US, Pay Later, and eligible alternatives.
features.payouts: Funds settle to the merchant's PayPal balance and can be withdrawn under account terms.

responsibilities.note: The business remains seller even when PayPal appears in the payment experience.
Checkout does not generally make PayPal the seller of the merchant's product.
PayPal supplies risk tools and eligible seller protection; coverage conditions apply.
The merchant supports and fulfills the purchased product.

strengths: PayPal, Venmo, Pay Later, and card options
limitations: Cross-border, currency-conversion, and dispute fees vary
Account holds and protection eligibility affect risk
Merchant receiving and withdrawal capabilities are country-specific
bestFor: Merchants wanting a quick checkout option
avoidIf: You want a Merchant of Record
You need one uniform global fee and integration surface
